originality.rationale:
Two layers distinguished.

(1) Claimed novel layer (FM non-extension on ribbon compactified-Prym pair with gerbe twist): if proved it would be outside Franco 2206.12349 (verified abstract: reduced projective planar C, dense reduced singular spectral curves; non-reduced ribbon explicitly excluded), outside Gothen-Oliveira 1012.5541 (verified abstract: A_{m-1} singularities, connectedness; non-reduced ribbon lambda^2=0 is not reduced A_{m-1}; v3 Thm 8.1 reference to fibre over zero does not construct FM kernel or Ext^1 pairing), outside Jordan-strata census and very-stable multiplicities (components/multiplicities, not kernel extension). No prior states named pair/sigma/+1 FM obstruction. But this layer is UNPROVED (see correctness), so earns no originality credit; unproved novelty is not novelty.

(2) Actually proved layer (ribbon extension nonsplit, fiber generator +1, Ext dim 3, Riemann-Roch numerics): textbook, not new. Ext^1_{k[u]/(u^2)}(k,k)=k via periodic ...-u->A-u->A->k->0 with zero Hom differentials is a standard exercise (Eisenbud Commutative Algebra, Weibel Homological Algebra); sheaf-Ext=K^-1 from u*N=0 and global Ext^1=H^1(K^-1) dim 3g-3-? (=3 for g=2) via Serre duality and H^0(K^-1)=0 is routine ribbon cohomology (Bayer-Eisenbud ribbons; Drézet; Ellenberg). The named equation y^2=x^6-1 is unused beyond separability (disc!=0) and existence of rational Weierstrass point (1,0); any genus>=1 curve with rational point gives identical +1. Calling the canonical generator '+1' is normalization, not discovery. No prior citation needed beyond textbooks; timestamp/failed search does not create priority. Hence proved content is parameter substitution of standard algebra.

Therefore no rigorously established new result. Originality FAIL (never repairable).

value.rationale:
PRESET_FALLBACK assessment: exact fallback NOT completed (partial only), so no Admission conditional value presumption applies; audit normally. (Also ADMISSION_DEFECT: Admission fallback_qualification assumed <xi,sigma>=+1 'hence ... no MCM extension exists' and 'fixes sharp reduced/non-reduced boundary'; artifacts themselves admit twisted-splitting global step remains open, so that hence was materially false and unavailable at Admission.)

Proved fragment alone (ribbon structure nonsplit, +1 fiber generator) is textbook restatement / mere parameter substitution: applies standard dual-numbers Ext and Riemann-Roch to one explicit smooth genus-2 curve where the equation plays no role. The '+1' is not a non-trivial invariant that could have been otherwise (for A=k[u]/(u^2) the structure extension is always the generator); certification by linear-algebra printout does not rescue arbitrary scope. Object (central fiber/ribbon) is motivated, but invariant is mechanically implied by general ribbon theory for any ribbon, so fails the motivated-exact-invariant test (value not known/mechanically implied prong fails). No future researcher needs to retrieve '+1 on y^2=x^6-1 at (1,0)' because the general fact covers all cases.

Claimed stop-sign value ('Poincare-kernel route stops at nilpotent cone, start from new method') would be valuable if proved, but requires the missing FM bridge; an unproved stop sign has no retrieval value and cannot be cited to block future attempts. Incomplete census honestly described does not erase headline, but here headline itself is missing. No bounded addition of identity/motivation/interpretation can create substantive FM result without new research direction. Intrinsic low value / missing substantive result. Value FAIL.
